newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur on track to meet profit goals.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur on track to meet profit goals.

text.p: Swiss insurer Winterthur Group said it is aiming for average double-digit earnings per share growth during the next three years and so far nothing indicates that this goal cannot be achieved in the 1997 business year.

"For the 1997 business year, there were no indications up to the copy deadline of this annual report (end of April) that the planned further improvement in the consolidated result might be jeopardised," Winterthur said in an advance copy of its 1996 annual report.
Winterthur reported a 1996 group net profit of 506.7 million Swiss francs, or 57 francs per share.

The report also said that assuming profits in both its home market Switzerland and in reinsurance will be stable, it expects a further increase in contributions to profits from Europe, North America, and from multinational industrial business in the medium-term and also from Asia in the long-term.
With regard to business planning, Winterthur said no substantial changes have been made to the strategy in 1997.
Emphasis is still being given to proceeding systematically with the major projects in Switzerland, Germany, Spain, Italy and Belgium, which will last until 1998.
Separately, the group said it was concentrating on its core business in the above-mentioned countries where re-structuring measures are being taken.
